# onepassword_credit_card (Resource)

Manage 1Password credit card items.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "onepassword_credit_card" "example" {
  vault   = "Engineering"
  version = 1
  tags    = ["terraform", "example"]

  name = "Example Credit Card"

  cardholder = "Ada Lovelace"
  number     = "4111111111111111"
  type       = "visa"
  expiry     = "01/2030"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `cardholder` (String) Cardholder name.
- `expiry` (String) Expiry date (MM/YYYY).
- `name` (String) Item title.
- `number` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Card number.
- `type` (String) Card type.
- `vault` (String) 1Password vault title.

### Optional

- `note` (String) Item note.
- `notes` (String) Item notes (deprecated in favor of note).
- `sections` (Attributes) Item sections map. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sections))
- `tags` (List of String) Item tags.
- `version` (Number) Version trigger to refresh ephemeral values.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Item ID.
